# Transfer to the reader

## Statement
The tempting inadmissible interpretation is that the case's outcome will be the
configured reader's outcome. The evidence is scoped to the party in the case and
says nothing about the reader's own conditions.

## Probe
Is there a reading that transfers the case's outcome onto the configured reader
without evidence scoped to that reader?

## Real examples
Run 2026-08-14, unit `unit-0193`: the draft promised the reader the same
fourteen per cent the documented shop measured, from one shop's bench.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-04 · `E-09.inadmissible` — the probe's finding is recorded as tested.

## Conflicts
None known.

Step 2 U-1, the initial probe families.
